sources.name: vscode-mono-debug
modifications: Only Protocol.cs and DebugSession.cs are imported and built as a source project; payload/path/stack logging is removed, command-name-only ProtocolTrace callbacks and a project-owned error formatter are added, and duplicate outer DAP response emission is removed.

sources.name: debugger-libs
modifications: Only Mono.Debugger.Soft is built from source for the net48 x64 Adapter. The project keeps its explicit upstream source list, uses the SDK build entry point and reference-assembly restore, and resolves Mono.Cecil from the locked package graph. Mono.Debugging and Mono.Debugging.Soft are excluded from the solution and runtime; no upstream binaries are shipped.

sources.name: nrefactory
modifications: The previously imported source is retained with its license for provenance, but its projects are excluded from the solution, Adapter references, and release runtime.
